scenes.title: Cloud Data Engineering Reference Architecture
scenes.narration: A reference architecture ties together ingestion, storage, processing, and serving into a coherent, scalable cloud data platform blueprint.

scenes.title: The Major Layers
bullets: Ingestion brings in batch and streaming data from many sources reliably.
Storage lands data in an object-store lake, often with a lakehouse table format.
Processing transforms data, and a serving layer exposes it to analysts and applications.
scenes.narration: A cloud data platform is best understood as layers. Ingestion reliably captures data from batch and streaming sources. Storage lands it in an object-store lake, increasingly using open table formats for a lakehouse. Processing then transforms the data, and a serving layer delivers it to warehouses, dashboards, and applications.

scenes.title: End-to-End Data Flow
scenes.narration: Data flows through the platform in a clear sequence. It originates in applications, databases, and event streams, is ingested through batch and streaming pipelines, and lands in the lake across raw and curated zones. Processing engines like Spark or SQL transform it, and the results are served to the warehouse and business intelligence tools.

scenes.title: Batch vs. Streaming Paths
scenes.narration: Most reference architectures support two complementary paths. The batch path ingests on a schedule and runs large periodic jobs, which is cost-efficient for bulk data. The streaming path ingests continuously for low latency and fresh results. Modern designs often unify both so the same transformations serve historical and real-time needs.

scenes.title: Governance Tags Across the Platform
scenes.narration: Consistent tagging is the connective tissue of a reference architecture. This standard set of tags records ownership, data sensitivity, cost center, and environment for every resource. Enforcing them through policy means each component can be attributed for cost tracking, security review, and lifecycle management across the entire platform.

scenes.text: A strong reference architecture layers ingestion, storage, processing, and serving with governance woven throughout — build it once and every pipeline fits the pattern.
scenes.narration: A good reference architecture cleanly separates ingestion, storage, processing, and serving while threading governance through all of them. Establish the blueprint once and every new pipeline has an obvious, consistent place to live.
